description: This file defines a singleton object 'SessionLikesStore2' that provides a utility to reset the in-memory session-rated content state, primarily for testing or preview purposes. It uses reflection to access and clear an internal set within another class 'RatedStore.Session'.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the in-memory set of session-rated content, allowing the UI to reset the rating panel for the same content during preview or QA.
